title: The Kazi Abu Yusuf with Harun al-Rashid and Queen Zubaydah
logline: A mark on the caliph's bed almost wrecks his marriage, until a patient judge looks up, finds a crack in the ceiling and knocks a bat out of it; then he wins the room again with a joke about two fruits.
moral: Do not judge in haste or on appearances: look for the evidence, and hear the absent party before you rule.
tone: A bedroom farce told with tact: real fear and hurt in the first third, a detective reveal in the middle, warm courtly comedy at the end. The delicate subject stays abstract on screen.

beats.summary: The caliph goes to his bed to rest.
He sees a fresh mark on the coverlet and thinks the worst.
He angrily demands an answer from Zubaydah.
She honestly does not know its source.
He sends for Judge Abu Yusuf.
The judge hears both and will not hurry.
He looks up and spots a crack above the bed.
His theory: a bat hides there.
The spear goes in and a bat falls out.
The suspicion is gone; Zubaydah is cleared.
She promises the judge a great reward.
The fruit question: this kind or the one in the garden?
No judging the absent until they appear.
Each time he praises one, the other pleads its case.
Abu Yusuf leaves the palace delighted.

subtitles.ar: صعد الخليفة هارون الرشيد يومًا إلى فراشه ليستريح،|فرأى على الغطاء أثرًا حديثًا ظنه منيًا.|فوجئ واشتد قلقه،|ثم استدعى زوجته زبيدة ليسألها عما وجد في غرفة النوم.
subtitles.en: One day Harun al-Rashid|found a fresh stain on his bed that he believed was semen.|Shocked,|he summoned his wife Zubaydah for an explanation.

subtitles.ar: سألها بغضب: ما هذا الأثر على الفراش؟|أجابت أنه يبدو منيًا، لكنها لا تعرف مصدره.|لم يصدق الخليفة كلامها، واتهمها ضمنًا بالخيانة|وهددها بالعنف إن لم تقل الحقيقة.
subtitles.en: He demanded to know about the stain.|She agreed it resembled semen but did not know its source.|Harun suspected infidelity|and threatened her unless she confessed.

subtitles.ar: أقسمت زبيدة أنها بريئة وأنها لم تفعل ما يتهمها به.|بقي هارون مضطربًا، فطلب حضور القاضي أبي يوسف ليفصل في الأمر.|حضر القاضي وسمع ما قاله الزوجان دون أن يتعجل الحكم.
subtitles.en: Zubaydah swore she was innocent.|Harun called Judge Abu Yusuf,|who heard their accounts without immediately deciding who was at fault.

subtitles.ar: رفع أبو يوسف عينيه إلى السقف، فلاحظ شقًا صغيرًا فوق الفراش.|قال إن الأثر قد يكون من خفاش يختبئ هناك،|وإن سائله يشبه سائل الإنسان كما تفترض الحكاية القديمة.
subtitles.en: The judge looked up and noticed a crack above the bed.|In the tale he suggested a bat hiding there|might have left a similar-looking fluid.

subtitles.ar: طلب القاضي رمحًا طويلًا وأدخله في الشق.|سقط خفاش من السقف،|فاعتبر الجميع ذلك تفسيرًا للأثر الموجود على الفراش.|زالت شكوك الخليفة، وظهرت براءة زبيدة في نظر الحاضرين.
subtitles.en: He probed the crack with a spear,|and a bat fell out.|Those present accepted this as the explanation,|clearing Zubaydah of suspicion.

subtitles.ar: فرحت زبيدة كثيرًا ووعدت القاضي بمكافأة عظيمة.|ثم عرضت عليه فاكهة نادرة موجودة في المجلس،|وسألته: أتفضل هذه الثمار أم ثمارًا أخرى لا تزال في الحديقة؟
subtitles.en: Relieved, Zubaydah promised a splendid reward.|She showed him rare fruit in the room|and asked whether he preferred it to another kind still in the garden.

subtitles.ar: أجاب أبو يوسف بطرافة: لا نحكم على الغائب حتى يحضر.|فأحضرت زبيدة النوع الثاني، وذاق القاضي الفاكهتين.|سألته عن الفرق، فقال: كلما أردت مدح إحداهما، قدمت الأخرى حجتها.
subtitles.en: Abu Yusuf joked that one cannot judge an absent party.|When both fruits arrived, he sampled each|and said that whenever he praised one, the other argued its case.

subtitles.ar: ضحك هارون من جواب القاضي الذكي ومن تشبيهه الفاكهتين بخصمين أمام المحكمة.|قدم له الخليفة هدية ثمينة،|وأعطته زبيدة المكافأة التي وعدت بها.|وغادر أبو يوسف القصر مسرورًا.
subtitles.en: Harun laughed at the judge’s courtroom comparison|and gave him an expensive gift.|Zubaydah fulfilled her promise,|and Abu Yusuf left the palace delighted.

new_assets.name: bat
new_assets.description: Small comic bat, reusable for any cave, ruin or night story. At s 1: body ellipse 46 x 34, head r 16 with two pointed ears 18 high, wingspan 150 (each wing 3 scallops on 3 finger lines), feet 2 small hooks. Fields: flap (-1..1), fold 0..1 (wings wrapped round the body), hang (upside down from the feet), droop, rot, shrug, eyes (open, dizzy, shut), wink, plus the shared acting fields and silhouette.
new_assets.implementation: shape() polygons in navy #1b2340 with blue dot shading and a black brush outline; wings as fans of 3 quadratic scallops from the shoulder, angle from flap; eyes with eye2 so gaze and lid work; register through acting() in registry.js once approved.

owner_questions: The mark on the bed is drawn as a small abstract pale splotch with a question mark and is never named in lettering; the subtitles keep the script word verbatim. Default: keep it abstract.
Harun's mistaken belief is shown as symbols in thought clouds (a cracked heart, a dashed faceless man with a question mark). Default: use them.
The threat of violence is softened to a shaking fist raised above his own head and a wagging finger; he never touches her. Default: softened.
The bat is unharmed: it lands dizzy, shrugs and flies out of the window, and crosses the sky in the last shot. The script only says it fell. Default: unharmed, with the callback.
The judge's fruit answer is staged as a tiny courtroom in a thought cloud with the two fruits as litigants with faces (OBJECTION!, FRUIT v. FRUIT). Default: use it.
The two fruits are unnamed in the script; drawn as a red pomegranate-like fruit and a yellow pear-like fruit. Default: those two.
Added beats beyond the script: a servant who fetches the judge, the spear and the fruit; the couple holding hands and waving from the balcony at the end. Default: keep.

Invented English lettering: WHAT?!, ZUBAYDAH!, THIS!, THE TRUTH!, INNOCENT!, WELL?, A CRACK!, A BAT?, SO THE OLD TALE SAYS, EEK!, FLOP!, CASE CLOSED!, A REWARD!, THIS ONE..., ...OR THAT ONE?, ABSENT!, MMM!, WHICH ONE?, OBJECTION!, HA HA HA!, FRUIT v. FRUIT, AS PROMISED! Default: keep (trim in review if crowded).

SCRIPT: the English is a condensed paraphrase of the Arabic in several paragraphs (P1 omits going up to rest and "in the bedroom"; P2 omits the direct question; P3 omits "Harun remained troubled"; P4 "In the tale" stands for the Arabic closing clause "as the old tale supposes"; P7 omits "she asked him about the difference"). Both are kept verbatim.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; read timing.json for word cues. All cue times in this plan are word starts from timeline.md.

Word spans in the timeline are contiguous (a word's end is the next word's start), so the only safe effect slots are the listed pauses and the small gaps 11.52-12.12, 32.58-32.96, 79.36-79.80, 115.98-116.40, 146.78-147.72, 162.36-162.90. The spear tick at 91.78 sits on the word boundary before "سقط"; check it against the waveform and drop it if it touches speech. The bat's landing has lettering only, no sound.

Sets: bake the bedchamber once (palaceHall options + ceiling band + bed); live parts are the lamp, the bed dip, the crack eyes and the mark emphasis. Majlis is palaceHall as is; draw the garden in outside(ctx). The exterior is marketStreet with anchors.
Person figures are front facing: show "turning away" with gaze, a 4 to 6 px head shift, shoulder tip and x position, not a profile.

Use arm angles (aL/aR) for the poses that must read at phone size: the stiff point at the bed, the oath, the raised fist, the spear grip. Hand targets (handLW/handRW) for the tray, the gifts and the coverlet.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame; add hand blinks where lid is set. Suppress blinks in the held stares (10.6, 44.6, 69.6).
Three or four characters never move in unison: use stagger(i) for every group look and different breathe() phases.
Thought clouds are used only for mistaken beliefs, the theory and the told comparison. Keep figures inside at least 110 px on screen (scale 0.5 for the courtroom).
Lettering never covers a face; positions are given per scene. If two letterings fall within 1 s, keep the one named in the action.
Apply hit shake inside the picture panel only. Call the style finish last every frame.
Subtitles: the chunk marks in "subtitles" are final; check both languages against story/script.json by program.
warnings: Sensitive subject: the Arabic and English subtitles name the stain verbatim. The picture stays abstract, but the owner should confirm the film is suitable for the channel (see owner_questions).

New code is moderate: bat, bedchamber dressing with bed, judge preset, fruit pair, plus several planned small helpers that may not be in Library yet (iconBalloon, flush, worryScribble, handOver, laugh, headwear offset, spear, purse, jewelBox, balanceScale icon). Build them small and generic.
The narration is dense with few pauses: 16 quiet effects are planned; cut the ones at 50.55, 143.55 and 162.63 first if any feel crowded.
S10 and S17 carry a lot inside thought clouds; keep the real characters almost still while the cloud acts so the eye is not split.
P4 timing: "رفع" starts at 64.88 but the next word is at 66.84, so the judge's walk to the bed (64.9 to 66.6) fills a long word span; keep that walk slow rather than adding beats.
